rows.name: Cleveden
rows.description: Red light on pier-head

rows.name: Portishead
rows.description: Bright light on pier

rows.name: Breaksea Lightvessel
rows.character: One br. rev. lt. 15 secs. One red fixed light
rows.description: In 8 fms. 2 miles W. by N. ½ N. from One-fathom Bank buoy; one ball; red lt. shown from after part. Gong; signal gun.

rows.name: Avon
rows.description: White tower, 65 ft., on the E. side of channel. a red sector to N.W., and a green ray from W. to W. by S. at turn of channel

rows.name: English & Welsh Grounds Lightvessel
rows.description: On S. side of Bristol Channel, in 14 fathoms; a red ball, gong, gun, &c.

rows.name: New Passage
rows.description: Lights on pier and Charstone Rock for railway steamers

rows.name: FLATHOLM
rows.description: On South point. Light is red from S. ¼ E. to N. by W. ½ W.

rows.name: Briton Ferry
rows.description: North side of dock entrance; red light when passage is clear; green light when not open

rows.name: Usk, Newport
rows.description: West side. Light bright in channel, red over Welsh Grounds and Welsh Hook; bright North to land; bright up river

rows.name: Cardiff
rows.description: About 23 yards apart. One on pier-head

rows.name: NASH POINT
rows.character: Two bright fixed lights One red light
rows.description: White towers 1,000 ft. apart, S.E. by E. ½ E., and N.W. by W. ½ W. Red light from high lighthouse from N.W. by W. ½ W. to N.W. ½ W.

rows.name: Porthcawl
rows.character: One br., two red tide lts.
rows.description: On ends of breakwater

rows.name: Swansea Harbour
rows.character: 1. One red fixed tide lt. 2. One fixed bright lt. 3. Two green or red lts. 4. Two green or red lts.
rows.description: 1. White tower on W. pier-head; shown while 8 ft. water. Fog-bell; black ball by day ... 2. Additional bright lt. shown 430 yds. from extreme of W. pier, visible only to eastward 3. At South dock, vertically 4. At North dock, horizontally, red when closed, green when open

rows.name: Scarweather Sand Lt.-V.
rows.description: Off W. end of Sand, in 14 fms. A half globe above usual globe. Fog-trumpet, 2 blasts once in every 2 minutes. Signal Gun

rows.name: Mumbles
rows.description: A white tower. 56 ft. high, adjoining the fort

rows.name: Helwick Lightvessel
rows.description: In 16½ fathoms, off W. end of Sand. Fog-horn 5 secs. ev. 2 min. Warning-gun

rows.name: Llanelly
rows.description: One on Whiteford Point (on piles) from ½ flood to ½ ebb; from ½ flood to ¾ ebb on S. end of breakwater

rows.name: Burry Port
rows.description: Near head of W. pier while 10 feet water

rows.name: Saundersfoot, South Pier
rows.description: One red light or yellow ball while 8 feet

rows.name: Tenby Pier Head
rows.description: One red tide light for steamers, &c.
